name: @mnema/action
description: A GitHub Action that reads the mnema record on a pull request: it comments what the pull request does to the record and which changed files a rule governs, and it fails the check when the record does not verify as signed. Handed a checker key, it records whether each rule in force held, in the working tree; it commits nothing and is not published.
author: Felipe Sauer (https://github.com/felipesauer)
